devotions.title: Finding Peace in Chaos

devotions.title: The Strength of Unity
devotions.scripture: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.
devotions.summary: Exploring the power of community and supporting one another.

devotions.title: A Heart of Gratitude
devotions.scripture: Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.
